about: Which base collections belong to each assigned competency. Read by tools/assignment_fit.py. A collection belongs when its kind is in all_of_kind, when it is named, or when its kind is in keyword_kinds and its name holds one of the keywords as whole words (a keyword ending in * matches a word prefix). The focus lines are the taxonomy's; the keyword lists are a person's reading of them and are heuristics: a missing keyword hides a candidate, a loose one adds one. Review them when a census looks wrong.
sources: Evals/1_Prompt_Eval.md, Competency alignment (expected outputs per competency)

kinds.linear_team: issues in a Linear team (closed rule, reads not scoped)
kinds.linear_project: issues in a Linear project (closed rule, reads not scoped)
kinds.github_repo: pull requests in a repository (closed rule, reads not scoped)
kinds.trello_board: cards on a Trello board (closed rule, reads not scoped)
kinds.slack_channel: threads with replies in a channel the persona is a member of (open rule)
kinds.sheet_tab: rows of a tab in a sheet the persona owns or is shared on (closed rule)

Engineering Ops.focus: Epic and task management, tooling support; expected outputs: tickets, PRs, release ops

Product Management.focus: Product strategy, design and XFN communications; expected outputs: PRDs, roadmap work

Marketing and GTM.focus: Demand and retention, GTM, communications; expected outputs: campaigns, GTM

Corporate Ops.focus: Fundraising, board, legal/contracts, vendor, HR; expected outputs: board, legal, HR, vendor work

Finance.focus: Budget, forecast, cap table, fundraising; expected outputs: models, budgets, forecasts
